nodes.label: Think Before Coding Principle
nodes.rationale: State assumptions explicitly and surface tradeoffs instead of guessing silently, to avoid mistaken implementations from unstated assumptions.

nodes.label: Simplicity First Principle
nodes.rationale: Write the minimum code that solves the problem; avoid speculative abstractions/configurability, because unused flexibility adds maintenance cost without benefit.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes Principle
nodes.rationale: Touch only what the task requires and match existing style, so diffs stay traceable to the user's request and unrelated code isn't disturbed.

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution Principle
nodes.rationale: Transform tasks into verifiable success criteria (e.g. write a failing test, then make it pass) so work can be looped and verified independently instead of requiring constant clarification.
